priorityBands.P0: Blocks publication of an affected high-impact claim or requires immediate correction.
priorityBands.P1: High-consequence gap that should be resolved before related substantive content is published.
priorityBands.P2: Important gap needed for comprehensive coverage.

gaps.missingArea: Section 87A rebate eligibility on Special Rate Income under Section 115BAC
gaps.evidenceForGap: Income Tax Department e-filing utility for AY 2024-25 restricted Section 87A rebate against STCG (Section 111A) and LTCG (Section 112A) despite statutory ambiguity in the Act.
gaps.whyItMatters: Affects millions of retail stock and mutual fund investors earning under ₹7 Lakh total taxable income who face unexpected tax demands.
gaps.resolutionCriteria: Authoritative clarification circular issued by CBDT or landmark ruling by ITAT Special Bench.

gaps.missingArea: Judicial standards for Section 273B 'reasonable cause' relief in Section 269SS/ST cash property violations
gaps.evidenceForGap: Conflicting High Court precedents regarding whether commercial duress from real estate sellers constitutes reasonable cause to waive 100% penalties under Section 271D.
gaps.whyItMatters: Critical for property buyers coerced into cash transactions who face catastrophic 100% tax penalties on top of purchase prices.
gaps.resolutionCriteria: Comprehensive synthesis of High Court appellate jurisprudence establishing the evidentiary threshold for reasonable cause.

gaps.missingArea: Small & Medium REIT (SM REIT) initial listing mechanics and secondary market liquidity
gaps.evidenceForGap: SEBI introduced the SM REIT framework in March 2024 for ₹50 Cr to ₹500 Cr asset pools; historical secondary trading volume and distribution yield data remain sparse.
gaps.whyItMatters: Investors require empirical liquidity evidence before committing capital to fractional commercial real estate schemes.
gaps.resolutionCriteria: Tracking first 5 operational SM REIT scheme listings and publishing secondary bid-ask spread data.

gaps.missingArea: Operational reconciliation of 20% TCS on LRS outward remittances with advance tax filings
gaps.evidenceForGap: Authorized dealer banks collect 20% TCS on remittances exceeding ₹7 Lakh, but automated credit reflection in AIS/Form 26AS suffers from multi-week reporting lags.
gaps.whyItMatters: Causes cash flow drag and potential advance tax default interest notices under Section 234B/C for overseas investors.
gaps.resolutionCriteria: Documenting exact reporting timelines and corporate salary credit offset protocols under Form 12BAA.

gaps.missingArea: Empirical lifestyle and private education inflation data across Tier 1 Indian cities
gaps.evidenceForGap: Official headline CPI averages 4-6%, but urban middle-class expenditures (private school fees, healthcare, housing maintenance) escalate at 8-12% annually.
gaps.whyItMatters: Retirement planning and education goal calculations based on headline CPI suffer catastrophic underfunding over 15+ years.
gaps.resolutionCriteria: Publishing empirical 10-year fee escalation studies across Indian private universities and tertiary healthcare chains.

gaps.missingArea: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) future issuance policy after Budget 2024 customs duty reduction
gaps.evidenceForGap: Ministry of Finance paused fresh SGB tranches following the reduction of gold import duty from 15% to 6%, citing redemption cost considerations.
gaps.whyItMatters: Investors seeking sovereign gold exposure need clarity on whether secondary market purchases are the sole remaining avenue.
gaps.resolutionCriteria: Official Ministry of Finance announcement regarding SGB issuance calendar for FY 2025-26.

gaps.missingArea: NBFC-P2P platform transition compliance under RBI August 2024 Master Directions
gaps.evidenceForGap: RBI prohibited assured returns and instant-liquidity sweep products; operational loan matching restructuring is in progress across platforms.
gaps.whyItMatters: Lenders face liquidity lock-in and potential platform operational restructuring disruptions.
gaps.resolutionCriteria: Auditing updated user agreements and escrow flow audits of top operational NBFC-P2P entities.

gaps.missingArea: Cross-state electronic title verification depth for pre-2000 land records
gaps.evidenceForGap: Sub-registrar databases in several states lack digitized encumbrance certificates prior to the year 2000, necessitating manual physical ledger searches.
gaps.whyItMatters: Property buyers risk purchasing encumbered or disputed land if manual archival searches are omitted.
gaps.resolutionCriteria: Publishing state-wise land record portal digitization availability matrices across all major Indian states.

gaps.missingArea: Historical default and recourse rates on TReDS institutional invoice discounting
gaps.evidenceForGap: While TReDS is backed by corporate buyers, empirical recovery timelines when corporate buyers enter insolvency (IBC) require public data aggregation.
gaps.whyItMatters: Financiers and MSMEs require transparent risk assessment of delayed corporate buyer acceptances.
gaps.resolutionCriteria: Compiling published arbitration and resolution records from TReDS institutional exchanges.

gaps.missingArea: Judicial status of civil asset attachment for pre-2016 benami transactions post-Ganpati Dealcom
gaps.evidenceForGap: Supreme Court held criminal provisions prospective from November 1, 2016, but ongoing civil forfeiture orders for historical properties face split High Court benches.
gaps.whyItMatters: High-net-worth families with ancestral or historical property arrangements face uncertain title defense.
gaps.resolutionCriteria: Review petition adjudication by Supreme Court Constitutional Bench.
